Guildhall School of Music & Drama GREAT Scholarships 2024 is a joint initiative of Guildhall School of Music & Drama with the British Council and the GREAT Britain Campaign. The scholarship is offered to three students from India and Mexico who wish to pursue a MA Collaborative Performance Making programme at the university. Under this scholarship, a maximum of £10,000 will be granted to two students from India and one from Mexico for a year of study.
To be eligible, an applicant must:-
be a passport holder of India or Mexico
have applied and hold an offer for the MA Collaborative Performance Making programme at the university
have an upper second-class undergraduate degree with Honours (or international equivalent)
